title: Learning from fracture: Teaching language models to design through physical experience
abstract: arXiv:2610.17804v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How can language models learn to optimize physical designs through experience? We introduce FracLearn, an experience-abstraction-generalization framework evaluated through a deliberately unfamiliar, Tetris-inspired fracture game. The model first proposes architectures and examines simulated fracture responses to accumulate experience. Abstraction organizes these observations into conditional principles linking reinforcement placement, crack evolution and load transfer, with supporting evidence and failure conditions. Generalization challenges the model to combine these principles in new architectures and surpass the earlier design record. Campaigns demonstrate progressive refinement and recovery through hypothesis revision, yielding a best composite score 11.0% above the experience-stage record. Fracture analyses connect improved performance to crack deflection and temporary trapping as toughening mechanisms, alongside greater residual

translated_title: 从断裂中学习：通过物理经验教会语言模型进行设计
translated_abstract: 语言模型如何通过经验学习来优化物理设计？我们提出了FracLearn，一个“经验-抽象-泛化”框架，并通过一个刻意陌生的、受俄罗斯方块启发的断裂游戏对其进行评估。该模型首先提出结构设计方案，并考察模拟的断裂响应以积累经验。抽象阶段将这些观察结果组织为条件性原则，将加固位置、裂纹演化与载荷传递联系起来，并附有支持证据和失效条件。泛化阶段则挑战模型将这些原则组合应用于新的结构设计中，并超越先前的设计纪录。多轮实验展示了通过假设修正实现的渐进式改进与恢复，最终最佳综合得分比经验阶段纪录高出11.0%。断裂分析将性能提升与裂纹偏转和临时捕获等增韧机制联系起来，并伴随着更大的残余……
tldr: 提出FracLearn“经验-抽象-泛化”框架，让语言模型通过断裂游戏积累物理经验、归纳设计原则并泛化应用，最终设计综合得分超越经验阶段纪录11.0%。
en_tdlr: FracLearn, an experience-abstraction-generalization framework that enables language models to learn design principles from physical fracture experience, achieving a best composite score 11.0% above the experience-stage record.
